question: Related Questions Q. Fatwa regarding Jumuah Khutbah 2918 views Q. Respected Sir, I am working in Japan temporally for 4 months. We are 4 Muslims hear. Can we 4 of us perform Jumma Namaz as masjid is far off from this place and we don?t know any masjid close to our place. 1) I want to know the procedure to offer Jumma namaz and need necessary kuthbah if required. 2) Is Arabic kuthbah is must for Jumma or can we give kuthbah in local/understandable English language 3 )If you give me urdu/English and audio kuthba it will be great. 4) Should we offer complete 4 rakat namaz or kasar. Kindly provide the information Thanks and regards! 2159 views Q. Assalamuelekum I want to know about Juma ki Nawaz. I am living in Chennai. Earlier I was serving in Indian Air Force. At Air Force Camp it is training centre and there are more than 80 Muslim Trainees, who have been provided One big room for praying Salat. from last 20 yrs they were offering salat of Juma also inside Air Force camp. But All five time prayer is not regular in that room with Imam. These Air force trainees also can not go out of gate for offering salat of juma. Now my question is that whether Juma ki nawaj is farz on them,because due to restriction of Militry Service they can not go out in city and offer Juma salt.What they can offer Juma salat inside the camp or there any restriction according to Shariet and Islam, Or Zohar Nawaz is better for them .I approched the Local Mufti also Who is also from Darululoom Deoband, he says you ask this to Darool uloom Deoband it will be better, So Hazarat it is my request what is Fatwa says for these people, 3451 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 16965 Country: KR Title: Dear Mufti Sahib Assalam o Alikum! I am a researcher in a university in Pohang (a small city in south Korea). Here we have no local muslim community and masjid. Only few muslim students and scholars are present (from other countries) in the university (about 6 to 8). Some time even more or less because visiting scholars come here for a short time. Out of these muslims only 4 come for jumma prayer including me. My other three muslim friends (those who come for jumma prayer) offer jumma Khutba in English some even they say no word in Arabic except Bismillah. Please tell me if our Jumma prayer is valid under these circumstances or not. Some time there are only three persons for jumma prayer. My friends are of the view that jumma can be offered with three persons also. Please also tell me the minimum nember of persons required for validity of jumma prayer. This university is inside the city Pohang. Is Jumma compulsary here? One thing more I want to know is about the person who can lead jumma prayer. My friends have decided that jumma prayer will be lead by every one turn by turn. All other three friends of mine have no beard. They are very strict in their decision and do not want to even listen any body about it. I have told them that jumma prayer is valid only with Arabic Khutba and atleast with four persons but they are not ready to except it. Please tell me what should I do under these circumstances. Should I offer jumma with them or offer my Zuhar prayer alone. Jazakallah. Looking for an early reply in this regard. Wassalam Aman-ur-Rehman Question: Dear Mufti Sahib Assalam o Alikum! Should I offer jumma with them or offer my Zuhar prayer alone. Jazakallah. Looking for an early reply in this regard. Wassalam Aman-ur-Rehman Answer ID: 16965 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2051/1654/B=1430) At least the presence of three muqtadis excluding Imam is wajib. As well as it is necessary for Khutba to be delivered in pure Arabic language. The Imam must be distinguished by the characteristics of Imamat i.e. the Imam should be more pious and God-fearing among all of them. Moreover, he should recite the holy Quran with perfection and should be aware of all the Masael of salah as well. And if your friends follow all these things in future, you can offer Jumuah with them, otherwise perform your Zuhar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
